        "contents": "    /// Method \"codex/event\" with params.msg.type == \"task_complete\".\n    pub async fn read_stream_until_legacy_task_complete_notification(\n        &amp;mut self,\n    ) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;JSONRPCNotification&gt; {\n        eprintln!(\"in read_stream_until_legacy_task_complete_notification()\");\n\n        loop {\n            let message = self.read_jsonrpc_message().await?;\n            match message {\n                JSONRPCMessage::Notification(notification) =&gt; {\n                    let is_match = if notification.method == \"codex/event\" {\n                        if let Some(params) = &amp;notification.params {\n                            params\n                                .get(\"msg\")\n                                .and_then(|m| m.get(\"type\"))\n                                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n                                == Some(\"task_complete\")\n                        } else {\n                            false\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        false\n                    };\n\n                    if is_match {\n                        return Ok(notification);\n                    } else {\n                        eprintln!(\"ignoring notification: {notification:?}\");\n                    }\n                }\n                JSONRPCMessage::Request(_) =&gt; {\n                    anyhow::bail!(\"unexpected JSONRPCMessage::Request: {message:?}\");\n                }\n                JSONRPCMessage::Error(_) =&gt; {\n                    anyhow::bail!(\"unexpected JSONRPCMessage::Error: {message:?}\");\n                }\n                JSONRPCMessage::Response(_) =&gt; {\n                    anyhow::bail!(\"unexpected JSONRPCMessage::Response: {message:?}\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}",

{\n                    cmd.env(k, val);\n                }\n                None =&gt; {\n                    cmd.env_remove(k);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        let mut process = cmd\n            .kill_on_drop(true)\n            .spawn()\n            .context(\"codex-mcp-server proc should start\")?;\n        let stdin = process\n            .stdin\n            .take()\n            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::format_err!(\"mcp should have stdin fd\"))?;\n        let stdout = process\n            .stdout\n            .take()\n            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::format_err!(\"mcp should have stdout fd\"))?;\n        let stdout = BufReader::new(stdout);\n\n        // Forward child's stderr to our stderr so failures are visible even\n        // when stdout/stderr are captured by the test harness.\n        if let Some(stderr) = process.stderr.take() {\n            let mut stderr_reader = BufReader::new(stderr).lines();",

        "contents": " {\n        #[inline]\n        fn normalize_windows_path_for_display(p: &amp;std::path::Path) -&gt; String {\n            let canon = dunce::canonicalize(p).unwrap_or_else(|_| p.to_path_buf());\n            canon.display().to_string().replace('/', \"\\\\\")\n        }\n        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {\n            let result = codex_windows_sandbox::preflight_audit_everyone_writable(\n                &amp;cwd,\n                &amp;env_map,\n                Some(logs_base_dir.as_path()),\n            );\n            if let Ok(ref paths) = result\n                &amp;&amp; !paths.is_empty()\n            {\n                let as_strings: Vec&lt;String&gt; = paths\n                    .iter()\n                    .map(|p| normalize_windows_path_for_display(p))\n                    .collect();\n                let sample_paths: Vec&lt;String&gt; = as_strings.iter().take(3).cloned().collect();\n                let extra_count = if as_strings.len() &gt; sample_paths.len() {\n                    as_strings.len() - sample_paths.len()\n                } else {\n                    0\n                };\n\n                tx.send(AppEvent::OpenWorldWritableWarningConfirmation {\n                    preset: None,\n                    sample_paths,\n                    extra_count,\n                    failed_scan: false,\n                });\n            } else if result.is_err() {\n                // Scan failed: still warn, but with no examples and mark as failed.\n                let sample_paths: Vec&lt;String&gt; = Vec::new();\n                let extra_count = 0usize;\n                tx.send(AppEvent::OpenWorldWritableWarningConfirmation {\n                    preset: None,\n                    sample_paths,\n                    extra_count,\n                    failed_scan: true,\n                });\n            }\n        });\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::BacktrackState;\n    use super::user_count;",

        "contents": "//! QC Agent implementation\n//! \n//! Quality control agent for code analysis and merging decisions\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse schemars::JsonSchema;\n\n/// Result of QC analysis\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]\npub struct QCAnalysisResult {\n    /// Overall quality score (0.0 - 1.0)\n    pub quality_score: f64,\n    /// Code complexity metrics\n    pub complexity: ComplexityMetrics,\n    /// Test coverage percentage\n    pub test_coverage: f64,\n    /// Code quality issues found\n    pub issues: Vec&lt;QualityIssue&gt;,\n    /// Recommendations for improvement\n    pub recommendations: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Code complexity metrics\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]\npub struct ComplexityMetrics {\n    /// Cyclomatic complexity\n    pub cyclomatic: f64,\n    /// Cognitive complexity\n    pub cognitive: f64,\n    /// Lines of code\n    pub lines_of_code: usize,\n    /// Number of functions\n    pub function_count: usize,\n}\n\n/// Quality issue found during analysis\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]\npub struct QualityIssue {\n    /// Issue severity\n    pub severity: IssueSeverity,\n    /// Issue category\n    pub category: String,\n    /// Issue description\n    pub description: String,\n    /// File path where issue was found\n    pub file_path: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    /// Line number (if applicable)\n    pub line: Option&lt;usize&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Issue severity level\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub enum IssueSeverity {\n    /// Low severity\n    Low,\n    /// Medium severity\n    Medium,\n    /// High severity\n    High,\n    /// Critical severity\n    Critical,\n}\n\n/// Merge decision result from QC analysis\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]\npub struct QCMergeDecision {\n    /// Whether to approve the merge",

        "contents": "impl McpProcess {\n    pub async fn new(codex_home: &amp;Path) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        Self::new_with_env(codex_home, &amp;[]).await\n    }\n\n    /// Creates a new MCP process, allowing tests to override or remove\n    /// specific environment variables for the child process only.\n    ///\n    /// Pass a tuple of (key, Some(value)) to set/override, or (key, None) to\n    /// remove a variable from the child's environment.\n    #[allow(deprecated)]\n    pub async fn new_with_env(\n        codex_home: &amp;Path,\n        env_overrides: &amp;[(&amp;str, Option&lt;&amp;str&gt;)],\n    ) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        let program = codex_utils_cargo_bin::cargo_bin(\"codex-app-server\")\n            .context(\"should find binary for codex-app-server\")?;\n        let mut cmd = Command::new(program);\n\n        cmd.stdin(Stdio::piped());\n        cmd.stdout(Stdio::piped());\n        cmd.stderr(Stdio::piped());\n        cmd.env(\"CODEX_HOME\", codex_home);\n        cmd.env(\"RUST_LOG\", \"debug\");\n        cmd.env_remove(CODEX_INTERNAL_ORIGINATOR_OVERRIDE_ENV_VAR);\n\n        for (k, v) in env_overrides {\n            match v {\n                Some(val) =&gt; {\n                    cmd.env(k, val);\n                }\n                None =&gt; {\n                    cmd.env_remove(k);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        let mut process = cmd\n            .kill_on_drop(true)\n            .spawn()\n            .context(\"codex-mcp-server proc should start\")?;\n        let stdin = process\n            .stdin\n            .take()\n            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::format_err!(\"mcp should have stdin fd\"))?;\n        let stdout = process\n            .stdout\n            .take()\n            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::format_err!(\"mcp should have stdout fd\"))?;\n        let stdout = BufReader::new(stdout);\n\n        // Forward child's stderr to our stderr so failures are visible even\n        // when stdout/stderr are captured by the test harness.\n        if let Some(stderr) = process.stderr.take() {\n            let mut stderr_reader = BufReader::new(stderr).lines();",

        "contents": "        .await\n    }\n\n    async fn send_request(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        method: &amp;str,\n        params: Option&lt;serde_json::Value&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;i64&gt; {\n        let request_id = self.next_request_id.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n\n        let message = JSONRPCMessage::Request(JSONRPCRequest {\n            jsonrpc: JSONRPC_VERSION.into(),\n            id: RequestId::Integer(request_id),\n            method: method.to_string(),\n            params,\n        });\n        self.send_jsonrpc_message(message).await?;\n        Ok(request_id)\n    }\n\n    pub async fn send_response(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        id: RequestId,\n        result: serde_json::Value,\n    ) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        self.send_jsonrpc_message(JSONRPCMessage::Response(JSONRPCResponse {\n            jsonrpc: JSONRPC_VERSION.into(),\n            id,\n            result,\n        }))\n        .await\n    }\n\n    async fn send_jsonrpc_message(&amp;mut self, message: JSONRPCMessage) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        eprintln!(\"writing message to stdin: {message:?}\");\n        let payload = serde_json::to_string(&amp;message)?;\n        self.stdin.write_all(payload.as_bytes()).await?;\n        self.stdin.write_all(b\"\\n\").await?;\n        self.stdin.flush().await?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    async fn read_jsonrpc_message(&amp;mut self) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;JSONRPCMessage&gt; {\n        let mut line = String::new();\n        self.stdout.read_line(&amp;mut line).await?;\n        let message = serde_json::from_str::&lt;JSONRPCMessage&gt;(&amp;line)?;\n        eprintln!(\"read message from stdout: {message:?}\");\n        Ok(message)\n    }\n\n    pub async fn read_stream_until_request_message(&amp;mut self) -&gt;",

        },
        "contents": "    pub async fn function_call_stdout(&amp;self, call_id: &amp;str) -&gt; String {\n        self.function_call_output_value(call_id)\n            .await\n            .get(\"output\")\n            .and_then(Value::as_str)\n            .expect(\"output string\")\n            .to_string()\n    }\n\n    pub async fn custom_tool_call_output(&amp;self, call_id: &amp;str) -&gt; String {\n        let bodies = self.request_bodies().await;\n        custom_tool_call_output(&amp;bodies, call_id)\n            .get(\"output\")\n            .and_then(Value::as_str)\n            .expect(\"output string\")\n            .to_string()\n    }\n\n    pub async fn apply_patch_output(\n        &amp;self,\n        call_id: &amp;str,\n        output_type: ApplyPatchModelOutput,\n    ) -&gt; String {\n        match output_type {\n            ApplyPatchModelOutput::Freeform =&gt; self.custom_tool_call_output(call_id).await,\n            ApplyPatchModelOutput::Function\n            | ApplyPatchModelOutput::Shell\n            | ApplyPatchModelOutput::ShellViaHeredoc\n            | ApplyPatchModelOutput::ShellCommandViaHeredoc =&gt; {\n                self.function_call_stdout(call_id).await\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn custom_tool_call_output&lt;'a&gt;(bodies: &amp;'a [Value], call_id: &amp;str) -&gt; &amp;'a Value {\n    for body in bodies {\n        if let Some(items) = body.get(\"input\").and_then(Value::as_array) {\n            for item in items {\n                if item.get(\"type\").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some(\"custom_tool_call_output\")\n                    &amp;&amp; item.get(\"call_id\").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some(call_id)\n                {\n                    return item;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    panic!(\"custom_tool_call_output {call_id} not found\");\n}\n\nfn function_call_output&lt;'a&gt;(bodies: &amp;'a [Value], call_id: &amp;str) -&gt; &amp;'a Value",

        "contents": "    async fn send_request(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        method: &amp;str,\n        params: Option&lt;serde_json::Value&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;i64&gt; {\n        let request_id = self.next_request_id.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n\n        let message = JSONRPCMessage::Request(JSONRPCRequest {\n            id: RequestId::Integer(request_id),\n            method: method.to_string(),\n            params,\n        });\n        self.send_jsonrpc_message(message).await?;\n        Ok(request_id)\n    }\n\n    pub async fn send_response(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        id: RequestId,\n        result: serde_json::Value,\n    ) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        self.send_jsonrpc_message(JSONRPCMessage::Response(JSONRPCResponse { id, result }))\n            .await\n    }\n\n    pub async fn send_notification(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        notification: ClientNotification,\n    ) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        let value = serde_json::to_value(notification)?;\n        self.send_jsonrpc_message(JSONRPCMessage::Notification(JSONRPCNotification {\n            method: value\n                .get(\"method\")\n                .and_then(|m| m.as_str())\n                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::format_err!(\"notification missing method field\"))?\n                .to_string(),\n            params: value.get(\"params\").cloned(),\n        }))\n        .await\n    }\n\n    async fn send_jsonrpc_message(&amp;mut self, message: JSONRPCMessage) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        eprintln!(\"writing message to stdin: {message:?}\");\n        let payload = serde_json::to_string(&amp;message)?;\n        self.stdin.write_all(payload.as_bytes()).await?;\n        self.stdin.write_all(b\"\\n\").await?;\n        self.stdin.flush().await?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    async fn read_jsonrpc_message(&amp;mut self) -&gt;",
